bundle.shortDescription: LaTeX OCR: snip an equation, paste it anywhere
bundle.longDescription: Offline LaTeX OCR for the desktop. Snip or copy an image of an equation and paste it as LaTeX, a native Word/PowerPoint equation, Mathematica, MATLAB or Python into any application with one hotkey. Recognition runs locally.
